sm.$description: For smaller interactive elements and controls nested inside other controls, like a button inside an input or a chip inside a select.

xl.$description: Outer container radius for large surfaces that wrap standard controls, like modals and drawers. Larger than radius/standard to stay visually balanced with the content inside.

md.$description: Default corner radius for most interactive controls — buttons, inputs, selects, and chips. Use this unless a more specific token applies.

full.$description: Fully rounded corners for pill shapes and circular elements. Results in a pill or circle depending on the element's dimensions.

none.$description: No rounding. Use for elements that need hard edges — table cells, full-bleed images, or elements flush against a container edge.

lg.$description: Outer container radius for surfaces that wrap standard controls, like cards and popovers. Slightly larger than radius/standard to maintain visual harmony with nested elements.

2xs.$description: Minimal rounding for compact elements like tooltips, code snippets, and small badges. Barely noticeable — just enough to soften a sharp edge.

md.$description: Corner radius for standard interactive controls. Aliases radius/standard — prefer this token inside component definitions for semantic clarity.

sm.$description: Corner radius for smaller controls nested inside other controls. Aliases radius/small — prefer this token inside component definitions for semantic clarity.
